title: Conditional kappa 0.000998634658090835: finite bootstrap and exact coarse precision
body:
Conditional **κ = 0.000998634658090835** (`199726931618167/200000000000000000`), using **six fixed ordinary-bootstrap levels** with unchanged #384 circuits and paid profiles. This improves the previous three-level head of this PR by `958199/1000000000000000000` and #384 by `1958832/1000000000000000000`. It is a small finite-bootstrap/witness gain, with no local circuit change. The latest precision update removes exactly 10^-18 of intermediate rounding loss from our preceding six-level result by retaining 24 certified digits of the complex coarse saving.

This reuses our reviewed **#185 stopped-leaf bootstrap mechanism**. Each new level calls only the preceding completed ordinary level; coarse calls still decrease width. Six is fixed independently of input size. The proof supplies the positive atom/borrowing/remainder/stock gaps, finite cutoff for any fixed dominating stage constant, sequential constant choice, and restored-row/fixed-tape argument. The previous review covered three levels; this PR provides the conditional six-level extension.

With beta=eta=10^-18 and `s=(1-beta)*b-10^-24`, all **47 exact strict inequalities** pass. Six controls reject invalid outer witnesses and finite cutoffs. The next 10^-18 grid point is above **u/(1+u)** for the certified upper root endpoint u=b+10^-24, so no extra bootstrap depth or slack choice within the unchanged outer formula and paid profile reaches it. Five levels at these slacks fall short; the prior chain is separately replayed at its original coarse input.

**Validation on head `d9fb9410b1ae6f6ada376a1e7fd12bc176e476ea`:** full packaged local replay passed, including the complete pinned #384 replay and certificate regeneration, both independent rational moment engines, all six finite bootstrap stages, 47 strict inequalities, six negative controls and the upper-moment-root ceiling. Both dedicated GitHub Python 3.11/3.14 jobs passed: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38120170890. The broader repository matrix remains in progress; this PR is still draft.

**Current comparison:** #389 at `b3c45822ca847aec8c0c019bb04db30881fc2966` records exact κ `998634658090834606116833/10^27`. This witness exceeds that value by `393883167/10^27` (3.93883167e-19). Its title rounds to the same 18 decimal places. #389 contributes additional source-specific physical replay; this numerical comparison does not represent an equivalent full PR389 suite replay.

**Additional local validation using #389:** after checking 191 reused source files against #389's manifest at `b3c45822ca847aec8c0c019bb04db30881fc2966`, its unchanged `complex_replay.py` passed a fresh changed-complex replay: reference/mirror controls, all 1,023 rational columns, dirty scalars and private lifetimes, 948 exact Clifford frames and 3,122 directed transitions including phases, cover/data corrections, emitted global template, finite invoice and independent moment audit. That freshly emitted profile is identical to the profile priced here; both high-precision moment engines and the full outer witness then reproduced this PR's κ exactly. The baseline comparison used our previously completed full #377 run. This supplemental run is distinct from this PR's packaged #384 verifier; the full #389 bit suite has not been run here.

Reproduce: `python -B research/e8-outer-slack-refinement/verify.py /fresh/output`. Standard-library Python suffices. The complete #384 source verifier and its certificate regeneration run first. Immutable original sources, reviewed #185 proof, community review, finite-cutoff accounting, three-level witness, new proof and full exact witness are included.

**Scope:** all #384 assumptions/open obligations remain, including #382's kernel entrance/bit geometry/finite-bill obligations and #377's compressed-window, dirty-bank, Clifford/compiler, common-grid and analytic interfaces. The bootstrap explicitly retains the completed ordinary leaf, complete spectator, restored internal-row and fixed-tape contracts. It neither measures the actual machine constants nor discharges the suppliers' open splice/Clifford/invoice obligations. No unconditional exponent or new Lean proof is claimed.

Credits: the reviewed Rohan Arun #185 mechanism; #384 and its credited component authors; the unchanged #315 outer engine and its PR144/23/balanced-prefix lineage. Prepared by Rohan Arun with OpenAI Codex assistance. The three joint-dual metadata files reuse #318's source-pin repair without mathematical change.


All 58 GitHub checks now pass at `d9fb9410b1ae6f6ada376a1e7fd12bc176e476ea`; the fully replayed PR is ready for review.
